name: Modular Relaxed Dependencies (MRD)
description: Resolves the thin-air problem by tracking syntactic dependencies modularly, using a denotational semantics. Intended as a sound and compositional replacement for relaxed C11 atomics.

catSupport.note: Dependencies are computed denotationally over an event structure that holds many conflicting executions at once; the verdict is not a filter on a single candidate execution. Checked by MoRDor rather than herd7.
